title: 第23章 大师爆粗口第24章 就duang一下
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
少女的脸色，异常的难看。
她看着那位归元宗的弟子问道：“如今归元宗，都有哪位高人坐镇？”
弟子道：“我归元宗几乎所有在夜风国内的弟子，都已经被召回。
为首者乃是我归元宗的三大通玄境大修行者！
除此之外，还请了鬼算子大人，和伏魔寺的元通大师！”
少女两眼一亮，道：“鬼算子和圆通大师也在？那就有五位通玄境强者了，鹤老觉得能赢么？”
鹤老沉吟片刻之后，道：“如果赤血魔蝎，还有当年的修为的话，只怕根本不够看。”
“这……”
一时间，众人又是一阵沉默。
少女低头思忖了片刻之后，起身道：“鹤老，我们也去大殿吧。”
“嗯？”
鹤老一愣。
少女道：“赤血魔蝎，不仅关乎归元宗的安危，更关乎夜风国无数黎民百姓的生死存亡，我怎么能坐视不管？”
鹤老迟疑道：“可是大人，面对赤血魔蝎，就算加上老朽，也是杯水车薪啊！”
少女用右手，握住左臂，道：“我还有这个。”
鹤老见状大惊，道：“大人，万万不可！
那个东西是……”
少女一摆手道：“鹤老，此物本是因万民而来，为保万民之命而用，也是正道。”
鹤老闻言，陷入了沉默。
就在这时，一旁的罗天忽然开了口：“这位兄弟，你说圆通大师在你们山上是吧？”

旁边的弟子点点头道：“正是。”
鹤老心头一动，道：“罗公子认识元通大师？”
罗天摇摇头道：“完全不认识。
我就想问，这个元通大师，是个和尚吧？”
鹤老点点头道：“当然。”
罗天继续道：“那他是和尚，是不是会超度亡魂之类的？”
鹤老愣了一下，然后道：“伏魔寺主修金刚怒目，但毕竟是佛门子弟，大约也晓菩萨低眉，超度之类的事情，还是会的。”
罗天一拍大腿道：“太好了，那我也跟你们上山，我得求这位大师，给被我撞死的那家伙好好超度超度！”
众人：……
不过鹤老瞬间醒悟过来，道：“那好，罗天公子若愿意一同前往，那是再好不过了！
这位归元宗的小哥，劳烦领我们觐见凌虚子道长，我们也愿为归元宗出一份力！”
“这……好吧，既然诸位有此心，我在此先谢过各位，请随我来吧！”
说着，他转身就走。
content_en:
The girl's face was extremely ugly.
She looked at the disciple of Guiyuan Sect and asked: "Who is the master in charge of Guiyuan Sect now?"
The disciple said: "Nearly all the disciples of my Guiyuan Sect in Ye Feng have been recalled.
The leader is the three great practitioners of the Tongxuan Realm of my Guiyuan Sect!
In addition, we also invited Master Gui Tongzi and Master Yuantong from Fumo Temple! "
The girl's eyes lit up and she said: "The Ghost Operator and Master Yuantong are also there? Then there are five strong men in the Tongxuan Realm. Does Mr. He think he can win?"
After He Lao pondered for a moment, he said: "If the Scarlet-Blooded Demon Scorpion still has the cultivation level it had back then, I'm afraid it won't be enough."
"This..."
For a moment, everyone was silent again.
The girl lowered her head and thought for a moment, then stood up and said, "Mr. He, let's go to the main hall too."
"Huh?"
He Lao was stunned.
The girl said: "The Red Blood Scorpion is not only related to the safety of the Guiyuan Sect, but also the life and death of countless people in the Night Wind Kingdom. How can I just sit back and watch?"
Mr. He hesitated and said: "But sir, facing the red-blooded scorpion, even if you add the old man, it will be a drop in the bucket!"
The girl held her left arm with her right hand and said, "I still have this."
He Lao was shocked when he saw this and said: "Sir, you must not do this!
That thing is..."
The girl waved her hand and said: "Old He, this thing is originally for the sake of all peoples, and it is used to protect the lives of all peoples. It is also the right way."
Hearing this, Mr. He fell into silence.
At this moment, Luo Tian on the side suddenly spoke: "Brother, you said Master Yuantong is on your mountain, right?"
The disciple next to him nodded and said: "Exactly."
Mr. He's heart moved and he asked, "Master Luo, do you know Master Yuantong?"
Luo Tian shook his head and said, "I don't know him at all.
I just want to ask, is this Master Yuantong a monk? "
Mr. He nodded and said, "Of course."
Luo Tian continued: "Then he is a monk. Can he save the souls of the dead?"
Mr. He was stunned for a moment, and then said: "The master of Fumo Temple is Vajra Angry Eyes, but after all, he is a disciple of Buddhism. He probably knows that Bodhisattvas can lower their eyebrows and achieve salvation."
Luo Tian slapped his thigh and said, "Great, then I will go up the mountain with you. I have to ask this master to give a good blessing to the guy who was killed by me!"
Everyone:...
But Mr. He suddenly came to his senses and said, "Well, if Mr. Luo Tian is willing to go together, that would be great!
This little brother from the Guiyuan Sect, please take us to see Taoist Master Ling Xuzi. We are also willing to contribute to the Guiyuan Sect! "
"This...well, since you all have this intention, I would like to thank you in advance, please come with me!"
With that said, he turned and left.
